sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Shawbury United on Saturday 21 November at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with a recent win and sit top of the table on 34 points from 16 games, while Shawbury are mid-table on 20 points and have won just one of their last six league matches. This should be a strong opportunity for the leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: The title race intensifies with Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting second on 34 points, also in action on Saturday against Wednesfield Community (away). Casuals have won all six of their most recent league matches and trail Sandbach only on goal difference, making this a crucial period in the season. Eccleshall, third on 31 points, have momentum with four wins in their last five and are well-positioned in the battle for honours. Elsewhere on Saturday, AFC Bridgnorth host Wednesfield Community looking to maintain their strong form (9 wins from 14 games), while Stafford Town travel to Market Drayton Town—a clash between two mid-table sides with Stafford the slight favourites. Alsager Town entertain New Mills in a bottom-half clash with both sides struggling, while Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads in another fixture among the lower-placed teams. Foley Meir visit Dawley Town in a battle of sides fighting for mid-table respectability. Widnes Town, one of the division's poorest performers on 8 points, host Brereton Social on Saturday. On Tuesday, Alsager Town have a midweek fixture at home to Barnton, who have been in strong recent form with five consecutive league wins.
